# Security

## Report a problem

Please don't open a public issue for a security problem.

Email **hello@glassy.fyi** with "Security" in the subject.

Tell us what you found, the version you run (`curl -s http://localhost:3000/api/health`), and
steps to see it. Leave out real passwords, tokens and keys.

## What we support

The newest released version. `.env.example` names it. Please update before reporting if you
are behind.

## How a self-host is set up

What stays on your machine, what leaves it, and what to do before opening Glassy to the
internet are in [docs/security.md](../docs/security.md).
